pages.text: The c0de disk looks like an old floppy disk. It saves programs as YAML files and loads them again.
To save, right-click the PROGRAM block with the disk. The file goes to the folder $(1)c0de/programs$() in the world folder of the server. Saving also works while the program runs.

To load, right-click the floor at the start of an empty sheet (x=5, line 0). Pick a file from the list. The program is placed on the sheet. In survival mode, the blocks come from your inventory.$(br2)Recipe: a data item, an iron ingot and black dye, in any shape.
